description: Ship a UI surface that lets an operator paste a module path, see the extracted nodes/edges/warnings, view server health, and inspect recent extraction calls. The graph explorer is the human debug path when an automated consumer reports unexpected results.

requirements.description: Ship a UI surface that enables operators to: (1) paste a module_path and trigger extraction, (2) browse the extracted graph nodes, edges, and warnings in a structured view, (3) view server health status, and (4) inspect a log of recent extraction calls including timestamps and result summaries. This UI is the human debug path when automated consumers report unexpected extraction results. The UI must consume the Connect-RPC service exclusively (no direct DB queries or internal API shortcuts).
requirements.title: Graph Explorer and Diagnostics UI Surface

validation.notes: Test graph node list component renders all node kinds correctly given a mock graph response
Test graph edge list component renders import and reference edges with source/target labels
Test warnings panel renders structured warnings (file, kind, message) for partial graph responses
Test server health indicator displays healthy/unhealthy state based on Connect-RPC health check response
Test recent extractions log displays entries with timestamp, module_path, node count, warning count
End-to-end UI test: operator enters a valid module_path, clicks extract, graph nodes and edges appear in the explorer
End-to-end UI test: operator enters a path with parse errors, partial graph and warnings panel both populate
Server health panel reflects actual server status (healthy when server is up, unhealthy when server is down)
Recent calls log updates after each extraction without page refresh
Operator can identify the root cause of an unexpected extraction result without accessing server logs or running CLI commands
UI is accessible from a browser without installing any local tooling beyond a web browser

title: Graph Explorer + Diagnostics UI
